body:
Submitted from a phone, so I'll be brief.
I've been taking pericyazine, an antipsychotic, twice daily for about two weeks. It has a sedating effect, making thinking itself require effort. Two days ago I smoked cannabis with some friends, about five hours after my morning dose. There was a lack of 'body high', but I still felt a noticeable, beyond-placebo mental high. I found it easier to sink back into lazy thinking, with thoughts arising effortlessly rather than requiring exertion.
This state lasted for several hours, persisting through a half-hour nap and until my evening dose of pericyazine. I also drank coffee while smoking, since I'd found that it lessened the sedating effect, and it didn't prevent me from sleeping.
[Reported Dose: "one joint 5mg pericyazine twice daily"]
